title: How to Drive a Manual Car Without Jerking
hook: Stop dumping your clutch from stops.

script.narration: Stop dumping your clutch from stops.
script.visual_search: driver shifting manual gear stick close up

script.narration: First, raise the clutch pedal smoothly until the engine RPM drops slightly. Second, hold your foot right at that bite point for one full second. Third, add gentle gas as you release the rest of the pedal. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Have you ever stalled a manual car? Comment yes or no.

description: Master driving a manual car with this simple 3-step clutch technique. Essential driving tips for new drivers learning stick shift without stalling. Quick and easy guide to smooth shifting.
